'''Clan Vizsla''' was an ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan whose members throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] history included skilled [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], powerful [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]], and peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. However, the clan would become most closely associated with the renegade Mandalorian group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], formed by the barbaric clan member [[Tor Vizsla]], and later led by his kinsman [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Upon becoming the leader of Death Watch, I chose the sigil of my own clan to represent it. Why? Because our clan symbol represents the shriek-hawk in threat display, a noble Mandalorian symbol if ever there was one. And because if we are to reclaim our honor, clans such as my own must decide where their loyalties lie. When Vizslas see their own sigil adorning the armor of those fighting for the ancient warrior ways, perhaps they will remember their own lost honor.|[[Tor Vizsla]]|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
The Vizsla clan was an ancient [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan, its existence in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] dating back thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Though its history, Clan Vizsla counted a number of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] among their numbers.<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> During a collapse in power of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the Vizsla clan was responsible for the theft of the [[Darksaber/Legends|Darksaber]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This unique [[black]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] would be passed down through the clan for generations, coming into possession of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]<ref name="TMP" /> at some point prior to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> Following the foundation of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] in the aftermath of the [[Mandalorian Excision]] of [[738 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> several members of the Vizsla clan joined the peaceful movement, becoming members of the New Mandalorians themselves.<ref name="New Battlefronts" />

Perhaps the most notorious member of Clan Vizsla was the brutal [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Tor Vizsla]].<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> In [[60 BBY/Legends|60 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tor Vizsla and his followers broke away from the clans under the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] of the time, [[Jaster Mereel]], and formed the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] splinter faction.<ref name="HotM" /> The sigil of Clan Vizsla was taken on as the symbol of the violent and radical group,<ref name="CWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and the clan would become closely associated with the Death Watch.<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> However, the Death Watch's opposition—the Mandalorian soldiers loyal to Jaster Mereel calling themselves the [[True Mandalorians]]—could count members of Clan Vizsla among their supporters.<ref name="Warfare" /> After Tor Vizsla [[Death/Legends|perished]] at the [[Limb/Legends|hands]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="OpenSeasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref> Tor's Vizsla clan kinsman, Pre Vizsla, took command of the Death Watch and rebuilt it during the early years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], becoming the second Vizsla clan member to lead the faction. Pre Vizsla held an ambition to restore the glory of the Vizsla clan that had faded through the years, and make the name a feared one again.<ref name="New Battlefronts" />

==Notable members==
===Tor Vizsla===
{{Main|Tor Vizsla}}
[[File:VizslaHS-JFOS1.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Tor Vizsla]]
{{Quote|They called themselves the ''<nowiki></nowiki>'Death Watch'<nowiki></nowiki>'' and followed a barbarian called ''Vizsla'', who believed that the Mandalorians should conquer the galaxy.|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], on Tor Vizsla|<ref name="OpenSeasons" />}}
Tor Vizsla was a brutal, and barbaric soldier whose dreams of becoming [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] and returning the Mandalorians to their [[Mandalorian Crusaders|conquering]] ways were dashed by the ascension of fellow Mandalorian, Jaster Mereel, to the position. Mereel's attempts to return a sense of honor to the increasingly dishonorable Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] was met with objection from Tor, who gathered to him a group of like-minded warriors who had enjoyed their lives of unaccountability prior to Mereel's claim to the title of ''Mand'alor''. Under Tor, the Death Watch was formed, and he led his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] through the [[Mandalorian Civil War (True Mandalorians)|Mandalorian Civil War]] against Jaster Mereel's loyal "True Mandalorians".<ref name="HotM" /> Tor personally [[Battle of Korda Six|killed]] Mereel on [[Korda Six]], and through his machinations, led the [[Mandalorian Supercommando|supercommandos]] of the True Mandalorians to [[Battle of Galidraan|their deaths]] on the planet [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]], at the hands of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team. Years later, however, Tor would meet the same fate courtesy of Jaster Mereel's adopted son, Jango Fett, who hunted Tor to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and left the wounded Death Watch leader to be killed by a pack of [[dire-cat]]s following a lengthy fight.<ref name="OpenSeasons" />

===Pre Vizsla===
{{Main|Pre Vizsla/Legends}}
[[File:PreVizslaHS-AFIN.png|thumb|right|130px|Pre Vizsla]]
{{Quote|I am Pre Vizsla of Clan Vizsla. Death Watch is here to save you from these intergalactic gangsters that threaten our great city. This is a war, and we will win! Join me, and let us defend Mandalore against the criminals. We need ''action'', not pacifism!|Pre Vizsla|<ref name="Shades of Reason">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref>}}
Pre Vizsla grew up in an era of Mandalorian history wherein the peaceful New Mandalorians were the dominant faction, but Pre yearned for the New Mandalorians' downfall and a return to the widespread warrior ways of the past.<ref name="New Battlefronts" /> Having become the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], Pre was publicly a supporter of the New Mandalorian government and of its leader, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. In secret, however, he despised Kryze, her government, and everything they stood for, leading the Death Watch against those he considered to be a disgrace to all Mandalorians. Pre revealed himself and his intentions during a [[Fight on Concordia/Legends|battle]] with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and tried to kill the Duchess as part of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-backed plot to take over control of Mandalore from the New Mandalorians.<ref name="TMP" /> Two years later, Pre was aided by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and their [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] of [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] in a successful [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|coup]] against the New Mandalorian government. Overthrowing Duchess Kryze, Vizsla betrayed his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies but was killed by Maul in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|confrontation]].<ref name="ShadowConspiracy">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vizsla clan can find its creative roots in the [[2002]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, [[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons|''Jango Fett: Open Seasons'']], wherein the character of Tor Vizsla first appeared, but only as "Vizsla". ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', released seven years later in [[2009]], finally provided him with the first name of "Tor". Later, in [[2010]], the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' introduced the Death Watch leading character of Pre Vizsla, taking the surname from the previous Death Watch leader. Though both characters possessed the same surname and were Death Watch leaders, it was only with the publication of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' reference book that Tor and Pre were officially connected and, together with the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''—responsible for adapting the previous Death Watch symbol as the sigil of their clan—the Vizsla clan introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].
